source.name: McLaren Racing – Mastercard Official Naming Partner announcement
source.quote: Mastercard is set to become the Official Naming Partner of the McLaren Formula 1 Team from 2026 onwards

note: Estimated at US$100 million per season until the mid-2030s per BlackBook Motorsport (2025-08-27): https://www.blackbookmotorsport.com/news/f1-mclaren-mastercard-title-sponsorship-august-2025/
